title: Game Customised within Minutes using AI
author: Constant-Bowler9988
selftext:
I just found https://www.pixelsurf.ai/ which lets you create games using AI prompts and 100 of templates. Aaand you know what - made a flappy bird version of Sam Altman lol. 

Gonna try the same with Messi and Ronaldo face.

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
You can build anything you want.

*makes flappy bird*

I don't worry about guys like you coming for my gamedev job.

Also this is just an ad.

replies.author: Constant-Bowler9988
replies.body:
I’m with you dude, I just thought using AI to customise casual games is still okay right ?! 
and yeah - I thought people might think of it as a good meme idea.

comments.author: kucinta
comments.body:
It can make a game that takes developer 5-30 minutes to make like couple of minutes to make.

Yeah.

Now make open world adventure game with AI or even Stardew valley. Like is it cool tech? Yup.

Is it autonomous for complex tasks? Noooope. You need a lot of intervention to make anything more complex than a game that can be made in an hour or so.

replies.author: CoastalFlame59
replies.body: You say that but ai can create almost everything art wise. I can see it handling the coding part in another 5-10 years

replies.author: Gullible_Animal_138
replies.body: the art looks like shit no matter what for me. the coding part is where it's at, ai is definitely capable of coding something complex like that it just requires lots of tweaking

replies.author: CoastalFlame59
replies.body: Pixel art is meant to look like shit so idk ur point. I was leaning more towards the "stardew valley" style u were talking about originally

replies.author: Gullible_Animal_138
replies.body: pixel art is definitely not "meant to look like shit." it is small, but you can do some really artful stuff with the pixels. just look at nes games, even though they have the same limitations/dimensions games have drastically different art styles that set the tone. the art style is the first thing that makes an impression on any player, before they play it or experience the story or listen to the music they will almost certainly see how it looks. many people, including myself will write off a game that looks like low effort slop and nothing really conveys that better than ai art

replies.author: kucinta
replies.body: By art do you mean levels, animations, rigging, custom shaders, particles, art style consistent 3d models and textures all by text? Or do you mean 2D images and crappy inconsistent models?

replies.author: CoastalFlame59
replies.body: It can deffo designs levels, sprites. As for animation. You can use nanobanana to make it create different frames and then splice them together. Shaders and particles are also incredibly easy. I don't know what you mean by inconsisent models, that's all old news with the release of new models like gemini and nano banana

replies.author: kucinta
replies.body:
I believe it can do 2d but 3d is what I am interested really. Is it capable of making say earthquake shake effect (that looks good) with shaders or marvel style portal with shaders & particles. If you have to put up a lot of work to make it happen then it's AI tool but if you can describe that and it comes alive with simple prompt then it's a workflow.

I have seen AI capable of doing 3d models, textures, sure sprite sheets and so on but I haven't seen AI make full games, understand art style to a deep level or produce entire cities. It has been a tool that sometimes works and sometimes not, depending on what you ask and if it has a lot of training data to accomplish what you want. I tried to generate a sauna for example and I couldn't make AI make Finnish sauna.
